DEFEND THE LINE - PLAYTEST BUILD

Extract the ZIP, then run Play.bat on Windows.
Requires Node.js and an internet connection to load the Ruffle Flash runtime.
Keep the command window open while playing. Close it to stop the local server.
The game opens at http://127.0.0.1:8770/ (localhost only).

For a web host, upload index.html, game.swf and the ui folder together.
Serve through HTTP/HTTPS; do not open index.html directly from disk.

Includes the latest UI, automatic themed preloader, FOG intro audio and More Games link.
Testing shortcuts remain enabled:
  I: open shop during gameplay
  Ctrl+K: grant 2,000 money
The shop also opens normally after waves.
F11: browser fullscreen.

Audio autoplay depends on browser permissions.
This is the playable browser/SWF build; editable FLA/source files are not included.
